description: Members. Pin or unpin your own post (or a reply in your own thread). Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

confirm.description: Leave out for a preview. true commits, with the preview_token.

post.description: Post id, as the feed shows it.

preview_token.description: The preview_token the preview returned. Needed with confirm true.
